lots.title: (1) The Teeling Whiskey Co. Rum Cask 17 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey, Ireland, 50.8% ABV, Bottled 2021 (GB)
lots.what_it_really_is: Teeling Single Cask 17 year old single malt Irish whiskey, matured in rum cask, cask no. 3, bottled 12/2021, 70cl, cask strength (ABV on label partly legible, consistent with 50.8%), carrying the Eight PM 'New Zealand Exclusive' logo. Eight PM's own page says it is a 180-bottle release. Hancocks NZ importer sticker, batch L21-059, cream tube.
lots.what_the_title_misses: Eight PM New Zealand Exclusive single cask, cask no. 3, bottled 12/2021 (title says only 2021), non-chill filtered, 180 bottles (from the retailer page, not the label). Webb's category files it under Single Malt Scotch, which is wrong, it is Irish. Real omissions but not obviously valuable: no auction record exists to show the exclusive carries a premium.
lots.photo_evidence: Re-read all 3 photos and enlarged the front label. Readable: SINGLE MALT IRISH WHISKEY, AGED 17 YEARS, CASK NO: 3, BOTTLED: 12/2021, MATURED IN RUM CASK (partly cut off at edge), EIGHT PM logo with NEW ZEALAND EXCLUSIVE, Non Chill Filtered, Natural Character, SINGLE CASK. ABV figure on the right edge is blurred: reads as 50.8% but I would not swear to it from the photo alone. Back: ALC/VOL ~70CL, barcode 5 391523 278867, L21-059, Hancocks Wine, Spirit & Beer Merchants, Mangere, about 28 standard drinks. Photo 3: natural cork under a clear plastic wrap; the wrap looks loose or split down the right side, so check it. Fill at base of neck, good for age. Scan claims confirmed.
lots.condition: Fill base of neck. Cork top looks sound. Clear neck wrap appears loose or split on one side. Tube present (scuffed sleeve not visible in detail).

lots.title: (1) The New Zealand Whisky Company Wilson's 21 Year Old Matured Blend Whisk, New Zealand, 42.7% ABV, 500ml (GB)
lots.what_it_really_is: The New Zealand Whisky Collection Wilson's Matured Blend 21 year old, 500ml, 42.7%, barcode 9421014231500, produced by The New Zealand Whisky Co, Oamaru, in the black NZ-map gift box. Current-era release still sold new at NZD 459 to 499. The producer's page calls it 'The Last Casks of Wilson's', 70% malted and 30% unmalted barley, American oak ex-bourbon.
lots.what_the_title_misses: Only the back-label story (Willowbank Distillery closed 1997, 'VERY limited release ... from the last few remaining barrels'). That is the producer's marketing for a bottle still on retail shelves, not hidden value. Title already names producer, age, ABV and size; 'Whisk' is a typo only.
lots.photo_evidence: Re-read all 3 photos. Front: Wilson's Matured Blend Whisky, AGED 21 YEARS roundel, 'Distilled from the finest quality Malt and New Zealand Barley', Product of New Zealand, Wilson Distillers, Dunedin, 42.7% alcohol 500ml (vertical small print). Back label fully legible and matches the scan text, including barcode 9421014231500, 18 standard drinks, 500mL 42.7% abv. Photo 3: black cap with a vertical seam and a small nick or lifted point near the top right; fill at base of neck, good. Scan claims confirmed; no value-changing omission.
lots.condition: Fill base of neck. Black cap seal has a small nick at the seam, check it is the factory seal and unbroken. Gift box present.

lots.title: (1) Alistair Walker Infrequent Flyers Undisclosed Distillery Orkney 24 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky, 51.3% ABV (GB)
lots.what_it_really_is: Alistair Walker Whisky Co. Infrequent Flyers, AWW Co. Release No.124: undisclosed Orkney distillery single malt, distilled 1999, aged 24 years (bottled Aug 2023 per the roundel and base code 15.08.23), cask no. 5744, Moscatel hogshead, style 'Moscatel Finish', 286 bottles, 51.3%, 70cl, un-chill filtered, natural colour, single cask, with tube.
lots.what_the_title_misses: Vintage 1999, cask 5744, Moscatel hogshead finish, 286-bottle out-turn, Release No.124, bottled Aug 2023. Real details, but the title's 'Orkney 24 Year Old' already lets buyers find it, so the value effect is small. Which Orkney distillery is not stated anywhere on the bottle; 'Highland Park or Scapa' is inference, not a finding.
lots.photo_evidence: Re-read all 3 photos and enlarged the front label: UNDISCLOSED DISTILLERY (ORKNEY), DISTILLED 1999, CASK NO. 5744, REGION ORKNEY, OUT-TURN 286 BOTTLES, CASK TYPE MOSCATEL HOGSHEAD, STYLE MOSCATEL FINISH, 70cl, 51.3% vol, AGED 24 YEARS roundel (ring text partly legible, consistent with 'Bottled Aug 2023'), AWW CO. RELEASE NO.124 on the tube. Back label: un-chill filtered, natural colour, single cask bottling. Base inkjet code reads ...15.08.23. Correction to the scan: fill is at base of neck / top of shoulder, not 'in neck'; still a normal fill for a 2023 bottling. Black synthetic cap with a small V-shaped notch on the top ring, likely a moulding or tear-tab feature, not a fault I can confirm.
lots.condition: Fill base of neck. Cap intact apart from a small notch on the top ring. Tube present.
